instructions:
1. Sit on the high row machine with your chest against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
2. Grip one handle with an overhead reach, arm fully extended.
3. Pull the handle down and back toward your torso, driving your elbow low and squeezing your shoulder blade.
4. Pause briefly at the contracted position.
5. Slowly extend your arm back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed to the pad and back straight throughout.
2. Lead with your elbow to target the lats, not the biceps.
3. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you return.
4. Use a slow eccentric to keep tension on the back.
name: Hammer Strength Plate Loaded High Row Single Arm

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with both legs extended and arms at your sides.
2. Bend your right knee toward your chest until the thigh is vertical.
3. Interlace your fingers behind the thigh to support it.
4. Slowly straighten the right leg, extending the heel toward the ceiling until you feel the stretch.
5. Hold briefly, then lower and switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
2. Keep the opposite leg flat on the floor.
3. Move slowly without bouncing.
4. Stretch only to mild tension, not pain.
name: Hamstring lying curl up stretch

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with both legs extended and arms at your sides.
2. Lift your right leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight.
3. Hold the back of the leg with both hands, just below or above the knee.
4. Gently pull the straight leg toward your torso until you feel the stretch.
5. Hold briefly, then lower and switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the opposite leg flat on the floor.
2. Keep the lifted leg as straight as possible.
3. Move slowly and avoid sudden pulls.
4. Stretch only to mild tension, not pain.
name: Hamstring lying straight leg stretch

instructions:
1. Place a sturdy chair behind you and your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width.
2. Kick up so your feet rest on the chair seat and your hips stack over your shoulders.
3. Brace your core to keep your body straight.
4. Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor under control.
5. Push through your hands to extend your arms back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced to prevent your lower back from arching.
2. Lower slowly and under control.
3. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your elbows tracking slightly forward, not flared wide.
name: Handstand push on chair

instructions:
1. Hang from a pull-up bar with hands shoulder-width apart and feet off the floor.
2. Brace your core and let your body hang straight.
3. Keeping your legs together, bend your knees and lift them toward your chest.
4. Raise your knees as high as you can while curling your pelvis up.
5. Slowly lower your legs back to the start with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Avoid swinging; use controlled movement.
2. Curl your pelvis up to engage the lower abs.
3. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep a secure grip on the bar.
name: Hanging knee raises
